evidence_submissions_received.name: evidence_submissions_received
evidence_submissions_received.value: ("evidence_submissions"."source" = 'consultant_recorded') = ("evidence_submissions"."received_via" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_submissions"."received_on" IS NOT NULL)

evidence_submissions_received_only.name: evidence_submissions_received_only
evidence_submissions_received_only.value: "evidence_submissions"."source" = 'consultant_recorded' OR ("evidence_submissions"."received_via" IS NULL AND "evidence_submissions"."received_on" IS NULL)

inquiry_contact_kept.name: inquiry_contact_kept
inquiry_contact_kept.value: "inquiries"."anonymised_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("inquiries"."contact_email" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."contact_name" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."org_name" IS NOT NULL)

progress_updates_received.name: progress_updates_received
progress_updates_received.value: ("progress_updates"."source" = 'consultant_recorded') = ("progress_updates"."received_via" IS NOT NULL AND "progress_updates"."received_on" IS NOT NULL)

progress_updates_received_only.name: progress_updates_received_only
progress_updates_received_only.value: "progress_updates"."source" = 'consultant_recorded' OR ("progress_updates"."received_via" IS NULL AND "progress_updates"."received_on" IS NULL)

template_questions_sourced.name: template_questions_sourced
template_questions_sourced.value:
("template_questions"."basis" <> 'good_practice' AND coalesce(cardinality("template_questions"."legal_for"), 0) = 0 AND coalesce(cardinality("template_questions"."guidance_for"), 0) = 0)
        OR (nullif(trim("template_questions"."citation"), '') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim("template_questions"."locator"), '') IS NOT NULL)

template_questions_applies.name: template_questions_applies
template_questions_applies.value: ("template_questions"."applies_if_question_id" IS NULL) = ("template_questions"."applies_if_values" IS NULL) AND ("template_questions"."applies_if_values" IS NULL OR cardinality("template_questions"."applies_if_values") > 0)
